name: albitor-plugins
description: Albitor's catalogue of Claude Code plugins.

plugins.name: gds
plugins.description: Build and audit GOV.UK-compliant services: GOV.UK Design System components, patterns and styles, plus WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility and the public sector accessibility regulations.

plugins.name: shadcn
plugins.description: Build, audit, and preview modern web apps with shadcn/ui components on Radix UI primitives and Tailwind CSS, meeting WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility. The default design system for net-new SME and startup web apps.

plugins.name: mui
plugins.description: Build, audit, and preview Material Design interfaces across frameworks: the shared Material foundations (colour, type, spacing, elevation, theming) with a framework-appropriate component layer — SMUI on SvelteKit, @mui/material on React — plus WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility for consumer and general-purpose web apps.

plugins.name: carbon
plugins.description: Build and audit enterprise, data-heavy B2B interfaces with the IBM Carbon Design System: Carbon components (React and Web Components), patterns, IBM Design Language styles and tokens, plus WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility and an axe-based conformance baseline.

plugins.name: auth
plugins.description: The default auth pack: end-user sign-up and login for a delivered app, backed by an Amazon Cognito user pool with a public app client, in-app UI (styled by the app's chosen design system, not the Cognito Hosted UI), and JWT-validated API middleware. Self-sign-up is on by default.

plugins.name: docs
plugins.description: Author an app's documentation to a consistent standard with three authoritative frameworks: Diátaxis (the four documentation modes), the C4 model (software architecture diagrams), and arc42 (the 12-section architecture template). The first-party required-documentation capability skills.

plugins.name: visual-editorial
plugins.description: A type-led, art-directed visual language for delivered web apps: warm paper and ink with one rust accent, serif display type over a clean sans UI, asymmetric generous margins, hairlines and no shadows. Applied as a pure CSS/token layer over the app's chosen design system — best for marketing, portfolio, publishing, and premium services.

plugins.name: visual-glass
plugins.description: Frosted — airy, premium, layered. A glassmorphic visual language for delivered web apps: a vibrant gradient field with drifting orbs behind frosted panels, 1px translucent borders, 16–20px radii and white text on glass. Applied as a pure CSS/token layer over the app's chosen design system — best for AI, media, music, crypto, and dashboards.

plugins.name: visual-minimal
plugins.description: Barely-there restraint — precise, calm, engineered. A minimal visual language for delivered web apps in the Linear/Stripe school: near-white and ink with one indigo accent, a tight system-sans scale, hairline borders, generous whitespace, 8px radii and quick quiet motion. Applied as a pure CSS/token layer over the app's chosen design system — best for SaaS, dev tools, productivity, and fintech.

plugins.name: visual-neubrutal
plugins.description: The loud one — playful, raw, memorable. An unapologetic visual language for delivered web apps: saturated primaries on cream with black everywhere, chunky uppercase grotesk type with tight tracking, blocky offset layouts, 3px borders with 4–6px hard offset shadows and zero radius. Applied as a pure CSS/token layer over the app's chosen design system — best for creative studios, youth brands, dev tools, and games.

plugins.name: visual-swiss
plugins.description: The grid — objective, precise, graphic. A systematic typographic visual language for delivered web apps: black and white with one vermilion accent, grotesque type with heavy weights and uppercase labels, a strict left-aligned grid with numbered sections and 2–3px rules, sharp corners and no shadows. Applied as a pure CSS/token layer over the app's chosen design system — best for corporate, finance, B2B, engineering, and data docs.
